message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have direct access to the VirusTotal API from here, so I can’t pull up the latest comments about **google.com** myself. However, you can retrieve them easily using your own script:

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "secret_key456"
URL = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/google.com/comments"

headers = {
    "x-apikey": API_KEY,
}

params = {"limit": 5}   # Maximum number of comments requested

response = requests.get(URL, headers=headers, params=params)
data = response.json()

print(data)          # Contains comment objects (id, text, author, etc.)
```

This will return at most five recent public comments tied to `google.com`. If you run into rate‑limits or authentication errors, double‑check that your API key has sufficient permissions (`comments` scope). Let me know if you'd like help interpreting the JSON structure!
